{{Top}}
[[File:LAATi-SWE.png|thumb|right|300px|A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Attack]] Gunship]]
{{Quote|That starship has a lot of firepower!|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>}}
The term '''gunship''' described a variety of vessels. The term was used for small troop deployment and attack carriers or for small [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. Typically heavily armed and armored, gunships were designed to break through whatever obstacles prohibited the completion of their mission. They were commonly used for troop carriers, supply relief ships, and escorts. Some were designed to carry large ground vehicles and drop them onto a battlefield. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic Gunship was one of the most-used small spacecraft in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].
